title: US rapper Don Toliver postpones London show after Manchester gig evacuation

blocks.text: LONDON — Almost 90 people received medical checks after an unknown substance was released into the crowd at a Don Toliver concert in Manchester, prompting the evacuation of the 12,000 people in the arena, United Kingdom authorities said Monday, Nov. 23. Police said they were working to identify the substance, which caused eye and respiratory irritation in some concertgoers. One person was taken to hospital.
